name: B10-0213/2025 (PfE) – Targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo – defending religious freedom and security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns attacks on Christians in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, including the beheading of 70 people in a church in Kasanga in February 2025 by militants linked to Islamic State. It calls for action to protect religious freedom and security. It asks the European Union to freeze military aid to Rwanda while Rwanda supports the M23 rebel group, to review the EU-Rwanda raw materials deal, and to reform the UN peacekeeping mission so it better protects civilians.

- The Parliament asks the EU to freeze military aid to Rwanda and review its raw materials deal.
- It affects Rwanda's government, people in eastern Congo, and the UN peacekeeping mission.
- Next, the European Commission must report back on its review of the Rwanda deal.
